title: Remote viewer locates crashed Tu-22 in Zaire
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Remote viewer locates crashed Tu-22 in Zaire, about 1979 at Zaire, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Jimmy Carter said the most impressive thing from his entire presidency from 1976 to 1980 was Rosemary Clooney, this remote viewer in 1979 finding this TU22 Russian cargo plane
that same year the Russians and the Americans were in a race trying to find a downed tu22 Russian spy plane in Africa
tellings.difference: Adds that the Russians and Americans were racing to find the plane, calls it a spy plane, and credits Dale Graff.
tellings.link_reason: Rosemary Smith remote-viewing the downed Tu-22 in Zaire in 1979, framed as a program.

as_told.title: Rosemary Smith remote views the downed Tu-22 in Zaire

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says former US President Jimmy Carter called the most impressive thing of his presidency a 1979 case in which a remote viewer, someone said to see distant places with the mind, found a crashed Russian Tu-22 plane in Zaire, a country in central Africa. Michels names the remote viewer as Rosemary Clooney and calls the plane a cargo plane, and he tells it as a sign the government's psychic program got results.
